blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the angle measured from the line \(\ell_1\) to the line \(\ell_2\), where \(\ell_1\): joining \((2, 7)\) and \((-4, 5)\); \(\ell_2\): joining \((-7, 2)\) and \((1, 3)\). Also find the acute angle.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'angle from one line to another' wala sawal hai.
Har line do points se di gayi hai, is liye pehle dono slopes nikalne honge.
Phir Theorem 7, \(\tan\theta = \frac{m_2 - m_1}{1 + m_1 m_2}\), \(\ell_1\) se \(\ell_2\) tak ka angle dega; \(m_1\) 'from' wali line, \(m_2\) 'to' wali line.
Tan negative aaye to angle obtuse hoga, aur acute angle \(180^\circ - \theta\) hoga.
Plan: slopes, formula, angle, phir acute angle.
Yaad rakhiye: 'from \(\ell_1\) to \(\ell_2\)' ka matlab hai \(\ell_1\) ko ghuma kar \(\ell_2\) par lana, is liye \(m_1\) hamesha \(\ell_1\) ka hi hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\ell_1\) points \((2, 7)\), \((-4, 5)\) se guzarti hai; \(\ell_2\) points \((-7, 2)\), \((1, 3)\) se.
Maloom karna: \(\ell_1\) se \(\ell_2\) tak angle \(\theta\), aur dono ke darmiyan acute angle.
Tareeqa: do points se slope, phir Theorem 7. \(m_1\) us line ka jis se ghoomna shuru karte hain (\(\ell_1\)), \(m_2\) us ka jis tak pohanchna hai (\(\ell_2\)).

Slopes nikalein
\[m_1 = \dfrac{5 - 7}{-4 - 2} = \dfrac{-2}{-6} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[m_2 = \dfrac{3 - 2}{1 - (-7)} = \dfrac{1}{8}\]
Kyun: slope \(= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}\). Minus over minus plus ho gaya, aur \(1 - (-7) = 8\).
Dhyan dein: upar aur neeche points ki tarteeb ek jaisi rakhein; upar doosre point ka \(y\) to neeche bhi doosre point ka \(x\).

Theorem 7 lagayein
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{\frac{1}{8} - \frac{1}{3}}{1 + \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{8}}\]
\[= \dfrac{-5/24}{25/24} = -\dfrac{1}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{8} - \frac{1}{3} = \frac{3 - 8}{24} = -\frac{5}{24}\), aur \(1 + \frac{1}{24} = \frac{25}{24}\). Dono mein 24 cancel ho gaya, \(-\frac{5}{25} = -\frac{1}{5}\) bacha.

Angle parhein
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{5} = 11.31^\circ\]
\[\theta = 180^\circ - 11.31^\circ = 168.69^\circ\]
Kyun: tan negative hai, is liye \(\theta\) obtuse hai. Pehle positive value ka angle nikala, phir \(180^\circ\) mein se minus kiya.
Dhyan dein: calculator \(\tan^{-1}(-0.2) = -11.31^\circ\) dega; negative angle mat likhiye, \(180^\circ\) jama karein.

Acute angle
\[180^\circ - 168.69^\circ = 11.31^\circ\]
Kyun: meeting point par dono angles supplementary hain, jama \(180^\circ\).

Tasdeeq:
\[\tan 168.69^\circ = -\tan 11.31^\circ \approx -0.2 = -\tfrac{1}{5} \;\checkmark\]
Dono slopes chhote aur positive hain, yani dono lines halki si upar uthti hain; is liye in ke darmiyan acute angle chhota hi hona chahiye, jo mila.
Khulasa: is part mein do angles maange gaye the, \(\theta\) aur acute angle; dono ka jama \(180^\circ\) hai, aur exam mein dono likhne hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the angle measured from the line \(\ell_1\) to the line \(\ell_2\), where \(\ell_1\): joining \((1, 2)\) and \((3, 5)\); \(\ell_2\): joining \((2, -1)\) and \((4, 3)\). Also find the acute angle.
blocks.explanation:
Bilkul part (i) jaisa sawal: har line ke do points diye hain.
Pehle \(m_1\), \(m_2\), phir \(\tan\theta = \frac{m_2 - m_1}{1 + m_1 m_2}\).
Agar tan positive aaye to angle khud hi acute hai, alag se acute angle nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.
Plan: slopes, formula, angle.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\ell_1\) points \((1, 2)\), \((3, 5)\) se; \(\ell_2\) points \((2, -1)\), \((4, 3)\) se.
Maloom karna: \(\ell_1\) se \(\ell_2\) tak angle \(\theta\), aur acute angle.
Tareeqa: slopes, phir Theorem 7, \(m_1\) from wali aur \(m_2\) to wali line ka.

Slopes nikalein
\[m_1 = \dfrac{5 - 2}{3 - 1} = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[m_2 = \dfrac{3 - (-1)}{4 - 2} = \dfrac{4}{2} = 2\]
Kyun: slope \(= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}\); \(-1\) ko minus karna 1 jama karne ke barabar hai.

Theorem 7 lagayein
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{2 - \frac{3}{2}}{1 + \frac{3}{2} \cdot 2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1/2}{4} = \dfrac{1}{8}\]
Kyun: \(m_2\) (jis line tak ghoomna hai) numerator mein pehle aata hai. Neeche \(\frac{3}{2} \cdot 2 = 3\), aur \(1 + 3 = 4\).
Neeche \(\frac{3}{2} \times 2 = 3\) hua, is liye \(1 + 3 = 4\); phir \(\frac{1}{2} \div 4 = \frac{1}{8}\).

Angle parhein
\[\theta = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{8} = 7.13^\circ\]
Kyun: tan positive hai, yani angle acute; acute angle yahi \(\theta\) hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[\tan 7.13^\circ \approx 0.125 = \tfrac{1}{8} \;\checkmark\]
\(m_2 > m_1\), yani \(\ell_2\) thori zyada dhalwan hai; \(\ell_1\) ko thora sa anticlockwise ghumane se \(\ell_2\) mil jati hai, is liye chhota angle bilkul theek hai.
Ek baat aur: jab \(\theta\) khud acute ho to acute angle wahi hai, us ka supplementary \(172.87^\circ\) obtuse wala doosra angle hai.
